2607.25479.title: Architectural Backdoors in Vision-Language Model Supply Chains via Representation Steering
2607.25479.paper_summary: Vision--Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed through a model supply chain in which pretrained checkpoints, architecture definitions, text encoders, and exported computation graphs are distributed by third parties and reused across downstream services. This reuse model creates a security-critical trust boundary: VLM deployments inherit not only learned parameters but also executable behavior encoded in shared model artifacts. In this paper, we show that a malicious provider can exploit this trust boundary by embedding architectural backdoors into VLM supply chains through representation steering. Our attack introduces dormant steering logic into the model architecture through a trigger-gated additive modification of an intermediate representation, without poisoning training data, controlling downstream fine-tuning, or modifying prompts at deployment time. When the trigger is absent, the modification reduces to zero and the model follows its normal computation, preserving clean utility. When the trigger is present, a steering direction shifts the internal representation toward an attacker-defined objective. We evaluate the attack across multiple VLM families and downstream tasks, including visual question answering, text-to-image generation, retrieval, and semantic response biasing. The results show that the proposed architectural steering backdoor compromises integrity, safety enforcement, and ranking fairness while preserving normal behavior on clean inputs. We further show that shared VLM artifacts can carry dormant steering logic against downstream services, and we propose an auditing defense that inspects the executable logic distributed with model artifacts rather than only their learned weights.
2607.25479.paper_summary_zh: 視覺--語言模型（VLMs）越來越多地通過一個模型供應鏈進行部署，其中預訓練的檢查點、架構定義、文本編碼器和導出的計算圖由第三方分發並在下游服務中重用。這種重用模型創造了一個安全關鍵的信任邊界：VLM 部署不僅繼承了學習到的參數，還繼承了編碼在共享模型工件中的可執行行為。在本文中，我們顯示惡意提供者可以通過表示引導將架構後門嵌入 VLM 供應鏈，從而利用這個信任邊界。我們的攻擊通過對中間表示的觸發門控附加修改，引入了潛伏的引導邏輯到模型架構中，而不需要毒化訓練數據、控制下游微調或在部署時修改提示。當觸發器缺失時，這一修改減少為零，模型遵循其正常計算，保持清晰的效用。當觸發器存在時，引導方向將內部表示轉向攻擊者定義的目標。我們在多個 VLM 家族和下游任務中評估了這一攻擊，包括視覺問題回答、文本到圖像生成、檢索和語義響應偏見。結果顯示，所提出的架構引導後門在保持正常行為的同時，損害了完整性、安全執行和排名公平。我們進一步顯示，共享的 VLM 工件可以攜帶潛伏的引導邏輯對抗下游服務，並提出了一種審計防禦，檢查與模型工件一起分發的可執行邏輯，而不僅僅是它們的學習權重。
